---
title: "其他待评估发现 | Other Discoveries Under Review"
---

本页记录2026年具有明显学术价值、但目前尚未正式纳入主名单的发现。设置这一页的目的，是把“值得继续关注”与“已经推荐为世界考古大发现”区分开来。

This page records 2026 discoveries and studies of clear scholarly interest that have **not yet been promoted to the main candidate list**. The distinction separates “worth monitoring” from “recommended as a major archaeological discovery.”

## 分级排序 | Priority tiers

::: {.callout-note title="分级说明 | How to read the tiers"}
**中文。** 以下分级只决定下一轮审查优先级，不等于正式入选。第一档项目应优先做独立深审；第二档继续保留候选资格，等待更多证据或根据最终收录标准再判断；第三档作为重要研究动态保留，但原则上不优先晋升为“世界考古大发现”。巨石阵祭坛石单列为研究更新，不参加晋升排序。

**English.** These tiers set review priority rather than selection status. Tier 1 items should receive the next independent deep review; Tier 2 items remain active candidates pending further evidence or a later decision about scope; Tier 3 items are retained as important research developments but are not prioritized for promotion to the main “major discoveries” list. The Stonehenge Altar Stone item remains a research update and is not ranked for promotion.
:::

### 第一档：高优先级晋升候选 | Tier 1 — High-priority promotion review

1. **老挝石缸平原 Site 75“死亡之缸”** — 直接发掘、直接测年、长期悬而未决的功能问题，证据链完整。
2. **玛雅低地汞污染与湖泊生态崩溃** — *Science Advances*，为古代城市环境压力增加新的直接证据链，但必须避免“汞导致玛雅崩溃”的过度因果表述。
3. **Cova de la Font Major旧石器时代洞穴刻画** — *Antiquity*，显著填补东北伊比利亚旧石器时代洞穴艺术的地理空白；主要限制是部分图像缺少直接年代。
4. **Tunnug 1大麻使用证据** — *Science*，直接测年和墓葬情境很强；是否能够证明“实际摄入”仍存在实质方法争论。

### 第二档：继续观察 | Tier 2 — Continue monitoring

- **Kekova早青铜时代沉船** — 同行评议基础真实，但年代主要依赖陶器类型学，“世界最早沉船”仍需谨慎。
- **魁北克圣劳伦斯河原住民捕鱼设施** — 水下文化景观意义突出，但完整技术报告和年代证据尚待公开。
- **美国西南祖先Pueblo蓝铜矿溯源** — 方法明确，但考古样本量小。
- **Tampa Bay移民陶工社群** — 解释意义强，但属于旧材料产生的新认识。
- **Holzman石器与猛犸象牙生产** — 对最早阿拉斯加人群重要，但2026年的贡献主要是综合性推进。
- **北美晚更新世骰子与机会游戏** — 识别方法有创新，但“概率认知”属于更高层解释。
- **Etowah可可古DNA** — 长距离交换意义明确，但旧藏陶片的污染与使用情境仍需谨慎。
- **罗马统治与伊比利亚人口结构变化** — 高质量古基因组综合，但并非单一田野发现。

### 第三档：仅研究动态 | Tier 3 — Research developments

- **波利尼西亚现代人基因组与航海扩散** — 学术分量高，但证据主体是现代基因组而非考古遗存或古DNA。
- **Crawford Lake沉积古DNA** — 方法与人地关系研究重要，但更接近古环境/分子生态综合研究，而非传统意义上的考古“发现”。


## 1. Tunnug 1 / Uyuk谷地：约2800年前大麻使用证据 | Cannabis use at Tunnug 1, Uyuk Valley

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Uyuk Valley, Tuva, southern Siberia, Russia / 俄罗斯图瓦共和国乌尤克谷地；early 8th century BCE / 约公元前8世纪初。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** Tunnug 1早期斯基泰大型墓葬中发现1000多枚大麻种子和保存的人发；论文对其中6枚种子进行了直接放射性碳测年。毛发化学分析检出与THC及其降解产物相关的信号。研究者据此提出，这是目前最早的直接考古证据之一，显示大麻可能被用于精神活性目的。

**English.** More than 1,000 cannabis seeds and preserved human hair were recovered from the early Scythian monumental burial at Tunnug 1; six seeds were directly radiocarbon dated. Chemical analysis of the hair detected signals consistent with THC-related compounds and degradation products, leading the authors to propose the earliest direct archaeological evidence for psychoactive cannabis use.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** 值得作为新增候选，但表述必须保守。种子、直接测年和墓葬情境都很强；真正有争议的是作为“实际摄入”核心证据的毛发分析。美联社报道，未参与研究的弗赖堡大学医学中心法医毒理学家 **Volker Auwärter** 认为，现有毛发数据不足以区分真实摄入与墓中大麻造成的外部接触，并批评论文在这一核心证据上“far short of what would have been possible”。因此，“墓中存在大麻并与葬仪有关”证据强，“死者明确摄入并用于致幻”仍有实质争论。

**English.** This is a strong candidate for future inclusion, but the wording must remain cautious. The seeds, direct dating and funerary context are robust; the disputed step is the hair evidence used to infer actual consumption. According to the Associated Press, **Volker Auwärter**, a forensic toxicologist at University Medical Center Freiburg who was not involved in the study, argued that the hair data did not distinguish consumption from external exposure and that, for this central part of the study, the article “falls far short of what would have been possible.” Evidence for cannabis in the mortuary context is strong, whereas deliberate psychoactive consumption remains debated.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Caspari, G., et al. (2026). *Direct evidence for psychoactive cannabis use 2,800 years ago*. *Science*. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aeg3800

**Selected reporting / 媒体报道**

- [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/science/siberian-burial-site-reveals-ancient-use-cannabis-an-intoxicant-2026-11-05/)
- [Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/2af72e5afb915d835b233f14b20ad185)
- [University of Bern](https://mediarelations.unibe.ch/media_releases/2026/media_releases_2026/cannabis_was_used_as_an_intoxicant_as_early_as_2800_years_ago/index_eng.html)

## 2. 老挝石缸平原Site 75“死亡之缸” | The “death jar” at the Plain of Jars, Laos

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Site 75, Xieng Khouang Plateau, Laos / 老挝川圹高原Site 75；mortuary activity ca. AD 890–1160 / 葬仪活动约公元890–1160年。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** 对Site 75大型Jar 1的发掘发现至少37名个体的肢解遗骸，直接测年显示该石缸在数百年内反复用于次生葬。研究为“巨型石缸究竟是否与葬仪有关”提供了迄今最直接的证据之一。

**English.** Excavation of the exceptionally large Jar 1 at Site 75 recovered disarticulated remains representing at least 37 individuals. Direct radiocarbon dates indicate repeated use for secondary burial over several centuries, providing some of the clearest evidence yet that the megalithic jars participated directly in complex mortuary practices.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** 证据等级较高，值得进入正式补充候选的下一轮讨论。它解决的是一个长期存在的东南亚考古问题，而不是单纯刷新“最大/最早”纪录。

**English.** The evidence is strong and the discovery deserves consideration for promotion to the main additional-candidate list. Its importance lies in resolving a long-standing interpretive problem in Southeast Asian archaeology rather than setting a simple record.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Skopal, N., et al. (2026). The death jar: A new mortuary tradition at the Plain of Jars, Lao PDR. *Antiquity, 100*(412), 1050–1067. https://doi.org/10.15184/aqy.2026.10352

## 3. 波利尼西亚人群基因组与航海扩散 | Polynesian genomes and long-distance voyaging

**研究性质 | Nature of the study**  
**中文。** *Science* 研究分析1050名当代波利尼西亚人的全基因组序列，重建嵌套式创始者效应、岛屿间亲缘关系以及夏威夷、Rapa Nui和Mangareva之间的历史联系。

**English.** The *Science* study analyses whole-genome sequences from 1,050 present-day Polynesians to reconstruct nested founder effects, inter-island relationships and historical connections among Hawaiʻi, Rapa Nui and Mangareva.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** 学术分量很高，也直接讨论聚落史，但证据主体是现代人基因组而非古DNA或考古遗存。本站暂不把它列作“考古发现”主条目，可作为历史基因组学与太平洋聚落研究的重要相关成果。

**English.** The study is highly significant for settlement history, but its evidence comes from present-day genomes rather than ancient DNA or archaeological remains. It is therefore retained here as an important historical-genomic study rather than promoted to the main archaeological-discovery list.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Shanks, C., Huang, E. C., Thomassin, C., et al. (2026). Message in a bottleneck: Nested founder effects from French Polynesia to Rapa Nui and Hawaiʻi. *Science, 394*(6820), 216–221. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aec7662

## 4. 土耳其Kekova早青铜时代沉船 | Early Bronze Age wreck at Kekova, Türkiye

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Kekova region, Antalya, Türkiye / 土耳其安塔利亚Kekova海域；proposed ca. 2700–2400 BCE / 推定约公元前2700–2400年。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** 水下遗址保存约30件早青铜时代双耳罐和三件石锚，但木质船体没有保存。研究者根据双耳罐形制、装饰、泥料及区域比较，把遗址解释为一艘早青铜时代贸易船，并提出可能是目前最早的已知沉船。

**English.** The underwater site preserves roughly 30 Early Bronze Age amphorae and three stone anchors, but no wooden hull survives. Based on amphora form, decoration, fabric and regional comparison, the team interprets the assemblage as an Early Bronze Age trading vessel and proposes it as the oldest known shipwreck.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** 值得继续关注，但“世界最古老沉船”的年代目前主要建立在陶器类型学和比较材料上，石锚是否属于同一船只也尚未完全确定。它具有真实的同行评议论文基础，但超级纪录式标题应保持谨慎。

**English.** The discovery merits continued attention, but the “world's oldest shipwreck” claim currently rests mainly on ceramic typology and comparison, while the association of the stone anchors with the vessel is not fully secure. The site has a peer-reviewed publication, but the superlative claim should remain provisional.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Öniz, H., & Öztosun, C. (2026). Preliminary report on the Early Bronze Age shipwreck in the Kekova region of Antalya. *Journal of Maritime Archaeology, 21*(3). https://doi.org/10.1007/s11457-026-09532-3

**主要媒体报道 | Major media coverage**

- [BBC News — World’s oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c6gr80rk1yyko)

**相关视频 | Related videos**

- [BBC Newsround — World’s oldest known shipwreck reveals incredible Bronze Age cargo](https://www.bbc.co.uk/newsround/articles/cve8r27k1e3zo)
- [Reuters Connect / Anadolu Agency — World’s oldest shipwreck in Türkiye enters Guinness World Records](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/worlds-oldest-shipwreck-in-turkiye-enters-guinness-world-records/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX09XQU5BQ0FBVklERU8yMDI2MTEwNDQyOTYxOTIz)

## 研究更新：巨石阵祭坛石 | Research update: Stonehenge Altar Stone

**中文。** 这不是一个需要新增的“2026考古发现”条目，而是一个值得记录的学术纠错。2024年*Nature*研究把巨石阵祭坛石与苏格兰东北部Orcadian Basin联系起来；2026年11月更全面的沉积学、矿物学、地球化学和同位素研究排除了此前提出的多个苏格兰东北部候选区，认为其具体来源仍无法有把握确定。网站若今后提到2024年的“来自苏格兰东北部”结论，应同时注明这一更新。

**English.** This is better treated as a scholarly correction than as a new 2026 discovery. A 2024 *Nature* paper linked the Stonehenge Altar Stone to the Orcadian Basin of northeast Scotland. A more comprehensive 2026 study using sedimentology, mineralogy, geochemistry and isotopes ruled out several previously proposed northeast-Scottish source areas and concluded that the exact provenance remains unresolved. Any future reference on this site to the 2024 Scottish-provenance claim should therefore carry this update.

Pirrie, D., Bevins, R. E., Ixer, R. A., Pearce, N. J. G., Turner, P., Power, M. R., et al. (2026). Searching for the origin of the Stonehenge Altar Stone: New sedimentological, petrographical, mineralogical, geochemical and isotopic constraints. *Journal of the Geological Society, 183*, jgs2026-090. https://doi.org/10.1144/jgs2026-090

## 5. 魁北克圣劳伦斯河约1200年前原住民捕鱼设施 | A ca. 1,200-year-old Indigenous fish trap in the St. Lawrence River, Quebec

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
St. Lawrence River between Contrecœur and Verchères, Quebec, Canada / 加拿大魁北克Contrecœur与Verchères之间的圣劳伦斯河；approximately 1,200 years old / 约1200年前。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** 水下考古调查记录了一组大型石构设施，并在原住民知识参与解释的基础上将其识别为捕鱼设施。现有报道把它描述为魁北克目前确认的首个欧洲接触前水下原住民考古遗址。调查与蒙特利尔港Contrecœur扩建工程的预防性考古有关。

**English.** Underwater archaeological work documented a large stone arrangement in the St. Lawrence River and, with Indigenous knowledge contributing directly to interpretation, identified it as a fishing installation dating to approximately 1,200 years ago. Current reporting describes it as the first submerged pre-contact Indigenous archaeological site identified in Quebec. The work formed part of preventive archaeology associated with the Port of Montreal expansion at Contrecœur.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **有较强潜力，但证据公开程度暂不足以晋升。** 其价值在于水下文化景观、原住民捕鱼技术以及协作式知识生产，而不只是“第一”纪录。现在可以确认发现及基本解释，但尚缺完整技术报告或同行评议论文，特别需要核实年代测定方法、石构布局、沉积环境和功能诊断依据。

**English.** **Promising, but not yet ready for promotion.** Its significance lies in submerged cultural landscapes, Indigenous fishing technology and collaborative interpretation, rather than in the “first” claim alone. The discovery and basic interpretation are credible, but a full technical or peer-reviewed publication is still needed, especially for dating, feature layout, depositional context and functional diagnosis.

**Selected reporting / 媒体报道**

- [Ocean Decade Heritage Network](https://www.oceandecadeheritage.org/indigenous-knowledge-key-to-identifying-a-1200-year-old-fish-trap/)

## 6. 美国西南祖先Pueblo蓝铜矿远距离获取网络 | Long-distance Ancestral Pueblo azurite procurement in the U.S. Southwest

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Four Corners region, southwestern United States / 美国西南四角地区；primarily Basketmaker III and Pueblo I, ca. AD 500–900 / 主要为约公元500–900年。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** Schleher等对12件考古蓝铜矿（azurite）样品开展铅、锶和铜同位素分析。9件球状或残缺球状样品及1件加工样品与犹他州Lisbon Valley相符，另2件来自新墨西哥州Zuni Mountains。研究表明，至少到公元600年前后，祖先Pueblo社群已经获取或交换来自相距数百公里矿区的蓝铜矿。

**English.** Schleher and colleagues analyzed lead, strontium and copper isotopes in 12 archaeological azurite specimens from the Four Corners region. Nine spherical or partial-spherical specimens and one worked artifact were linked to Lisbon Valley, Utah, whereas two irregular specimens were attributed to the Zuni Mountains of New Mexico. The results indicate procurement or exchange of azurite across substantial distances by at least around AD 600.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **学术上很有意思，但目前更适合作为二级候选。** 优点是同行评议、分析方法清楚，而且为此前难以溯源的蓝铜矿建立了可行的同位素方法；不足是考古样本只有12件，尚不足以单独支撑一个大尺度交换体系模型。随着地质基线和考古样本扩大，其重要性可能明显上升。

**English.** **Scholarly strong but currently a second-tier candidate.** The study is peer reviewed, methodologically explicit and establishes a workable isotopic approach for sourcing archaeological azurite. Its present limitation is the small archaeological sample of 12 specimens, which is not yet sufficient on its own to define a large regional exchange system. Its significance may increase substantially as geological baselines and archaeological sampling expand.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Schleher, K. L., Thibodeau, A. M., Mathur, R., & Till, J. (2026). Spheres of blue: Isotopic evidence for the provenance of azurite in the Ancestral Pueblo world. *Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports*, 106088. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jasrep.2026.106088

**Selected reporting / 媒体报道**

- [University of New Mexico](https://news.unm.edu/news/unm-faculty-member-develops-method-to-trace-ancient-pueblo-azurite-sources)

## 7. Tampa Bay密西西比式陶器与移民陶工社群 | Mississippian-style pottery and migrant potters in Tampa Bay

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Tampa Bay, Florida, USA / 美国佛罗里达Tampa Bay；Mississippian period, broadly ca. AD 1000–1600 / 广义约公元1000–1600年。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** Duke、Torvinen和Wallis结合陶器成分、岩相学和放射性碳年代模型，重新检验Tampa Bay长期存在的一个问题：当地密西西比风格彩陶究竟是输入品、地方仿制品，还是外来陶工在当地制作。研究认为，彩陶的泥料、熟料掺和和成形技术与普通地方陶器存在系统差异，最能解释这些差异的是来自北方密西西比文化圈的陶工迁入当地，并形成一个掌握专门技术知识的制作社群。

**English.** Duke, Torvinen and Wallis combine compositional analysis, petrography and radiocarbon modeling to revisit a century-old question about Mississippian-style decorated pottery in Tampa Bay: imported vessels, local imitation, or production by migrant potters. Systematic differences in clay selection, grog temper and forming practices lead the authors to argue that potters from farther north migrated into Tampa Bay and established a specialized community of practice.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **值得保留为较强候选。** 它不是新出土的轰动性遗存，而是用材料分析解决一个长期文化接触与迁徙问题。证据由同行评议论文支撑，理论意义涉及迁徙、技术知识、身份与“社群实践”。是否进入最终“大发现”名单，要看本站是否把“旧藏材料产生的新认识”与新田野发现给予同等权重。

**English.** **A strong interpretive candidate.** This is not a spectacular newly excavated object but a material-analytical resolution of a long-standing problem of migration and cultural interaction. The peer-reviewed evidence bears directly on mobility, technical knowledge, identity and communities of practice. Promotion will depend partly on whether the final list gives equal weight to major new interpretations of legacy collections and to new field discoveries.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Duke, C. T., Torvinen, A., & Wallis, N. J. (2026). Secret recipes: Potting knowledge and migration in Mississippian (ca. AD 1000–1600) Tampa Bay, Florida, USA. *American Antiquity*, 1–25. https://doi.org/10.1017/aaq.2026.10227

**Selected reporting / 媒体报道**

- [Florida Museum of Natural History](https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/science/archaeologists-uncover-centuries-old-mystery-of-tampa-bays-secret-community-of-migrant-potters/)

## 8. 玛雅低地汞污染与湖泊生态崩溃 | Mercury pollution and aquatic ecosystem collapse in the Maya Lowlands

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Lago Cobá and Cenote Xcach, northern Yucatán Peninsula, Mexico / 墨西哥尤卡坦半岛北部Cobá湖与Xcach天然井；主要污染时段约公元1世纪至9世纪。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** Waters等利用湖泊与天然井沉积岩芯、放射性碳年代、汞浓度和多类水生生态指标，发现Cobá和Xcach在古典期出现显著的人为汞污染。Cobá约从公元40年前后开始升高，在公元250–300年前后达到高峰；Xcach的高污染持续更久，并在约公元720年前后达到高值。同期藻类、细菌及部分水生无脊椎动物指标明显下降。两个对照湖没有出现同步汞升高，支持污染主要来自局地输入，而不是区域性大气沉降。

**English.** Sediment cores, radiocarbon dating, mercury measurements and aquatic ecological proxies from Lago Cobá and Cenote Xcach reveal substantial anthropogenic mercury contamination during the Maya Classic period. At Cobá, mercury rose from around AD 40 and peaked around AD 250–300; contamination at Xcach persisted longer and reached high levels around AD 720. Multiple biological proxies declined during the contaminated intervals. Two comparison lakes lacked equivalent mercury increases, supporting a local rather than regional atmospheric source.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **高优先级待评估。** 论文把玛雅社会长期使用辰砂和液态汞这一文化实践与可测量的水质和生态变化联系起来，为“古代城市环境压力”提供了一条新的直接证据链。但目前没有甲基汞测定，也没有人体中毒的直接证据，因此不能写成“汞中毒导致玛雅崩溃”。更稳妥的表述是：汞污染可能构成干旱、森林变化等压力之外，一个此前被低估的水质压力。

**English.** **High-priority under review.** The study connects Maya use of cinnabar and mercury with measurable deterioration in lake water quality and aquatic ecosystems, adding a new line of evidence to debates about environmental stress. It does not measure methylmercury or demonstrate human poisoning directly, so it should not be framed as “mercury caused the Maya collapse.” The defensible conclusion is that mercury pollution may have been an additional, previously underappreciated water-quality stressor.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Waters, M. N., et al. (2026). Toxic mercury, aquatic ecosystem collapse, and the ancient Lowland Maya. *Science Advances*. https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aeh3280

## 9. 阿拉斯加Holzman遗址石器与猛犸象牙生产 | Stone and mammoth-ivory production at the Holzman site, Alaska

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Middle Tanana Valley, interior Alaska, USA / 美国阿拉斯加内陆塔纳纳河谷；约14.0–13.7 ka。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** 2026年的综合研究重新讨论Holzman遗址C5b和C5a文化层，指出约14 ka已经存在烹饪和象牙加工，约13.7 ka的C5a则保存大规模石英加工和猛犸象牙减材、坯料生产活动。研究把这些材料放入东白令地区晚更新世人群移动与技术传播的框架中。

**English.** A 2026 synthesis of the Holzman site examines occupations around 14.0 and 13.7 ka, including cooking, mammoth-ivory working and an extensive quartz workshop associated with ivory reduction and preform production. The study places these activities within broader models of Late Pleistocene dispersal and technological circulation in eastern Beringia.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **保留待评估。** 这是北美最早人群研究的重要推进，但部分核心象牙棒材料此前已经发表，2026论文的新增价值更多在于把石器、象牙生产、原料流动和迁徙模式整合起来。与Shég’ Xdaltth’í’相比，它更适合作为补充性而非独立“大发现”候选。

**English.** **Retain under review.** The study is important for the archaeology of the first Alaskans, but some of the key ivory-rod finds were published previously. The main 2026 contribution is the integrated interpretation of lithic production, ivory working, raw-material circulation and human dispersal. Relative to Shég’ Xdaltth’í’, it is better treated as a complementary candidate.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Potter, B. A., et al. (2026). Stone and mammoth ivory tool production, circulation, and human dispersals in the middle Tanana Valley, Alaska: Implications for the Pleistocene peopling of the Americas. *Quaternary International, 755*, 110087. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.quaint.2025.110087

## 10. 北美晚更新世骰子与机会游戏 | Late Pleistocene dice and games of chance in North America

**研究性质 | Nature of the study**  
**中文。** Madden根据293套历史时期北美原住民骰子的共同形态特征建立识别标准，再系统检索已发表的北美考古记录。研究认为，符合标准的最早骰子可以追溯到Wyoming、Colorado和New Mexico的Folsom文化沉积，由此把北美机会游戏的历史推回约12,000年前。

**English.** Madden derives morphological criteria from 293 documented sets of historic Native American dice and applies those criteria to the published North American archaeological record. The study identifies the earliest matching artifacts in Folsom deposits in Wyoming, Colorado and New Mexico, suggesting a history of dice and games of chance extending back about 12,000 years.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **值得待评估，但属于“旧材料的新解释”。** 文章的方法论创新和文化史意义很强，尤其是在如何客观识别史前骰子方面；但从“骰子”进一步推演到概率认知史，解释层级明显更高，不能把“认识随机性和概率”写成已经直接证明的心理事实。

**English.** **Worth retaining under review, but as a reinterpretation of existing material.** The methodological contribution is substantial because it offers explicit criteria for identifying prehistoric dice. Claims about cognition, probability and randomness are more interpretive and should not be treated as direct archaeological demonstrations of abstract probabilistic reasoning.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Madden, R. J. (2026). Probability in the Pleistocene: Origins and antiquity of Native American dice, games of chance, and gambling. *American Antiquity, 91*, 584–618.

## 11. Etowah密西西比文化遗址的可可古DNA | Archaeogenomic evidence for cacao at Etowah

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Etowah, Georgia, USA / 美国乔治亚州Etowah；11–12世纪。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** King等从Etowah早期筑丘阶段宴飨堆积中的陶片内表面提取并鉴定出与*Theobroma cacao*一致的古DNA信号。由于可可无法在乔治亚当地生长，如果这一鉴定成立，就意味着可可通过跨区域交换网络到达了北美东南部，其传播范围远超此前较明确的美国西南部材料。

**English.** Ancient DNA consistent with *Theobroma cacao* was recovered from the interior surfaces of pottery sherds from feasting contexts associated with Etowah’s early mound-building phase. Because cacao could not have grown locally in Georgia, the result implies long-distance movement of cacao into the Mississippian Southeast, extending its known pre-contact distribution beyond the better-documented American Southwest.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **值得待评估。** 同行评议论文和古DNA证据使它具有真实分量，但材料来自20世纪中期发掘、之后长期清洗和保存的陶片，污染和具体使用情境仍需谨慎讨论。研究能较有力支持“Etowah存在可可”，但尚不能确定产地、交换路线或具体饮用方式。

**English.** **Worth retaining under review.** The peer-reviewed archaeogenomic evidence is significant, but the sherds were excavated and curated decades ago, so contamination and precise use context require caution. The study supports cacao presence at Etowah more strongly than it establishes its source, exchange route or exact mode of consumption.

**Publication / 出版物**  
King, A., Powis, T. G., Argout, X., et al. (2026). Cacao in the Mississippian World: Archaeogenomic evidence for *T. cacao* consumption at the Etowah Site, Georgia. *PLOS ONE, 21*(8), e0353607. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0353607

## 12. Crawford Lake沉积古DNA与千年人地关系 | Crawford Lake sedaDNA and a millennium of human–environment interactions

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
Crawford Lake, Ontario, Canada / 加拿大安大略Crawford Lake；约过去1300年。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** Murchie、Emery等首次系统分析Crawford Lake过去约1300年的沉积古DNA记录，从植物、动物、藻类、真菌和细菌等多个类群重建生态变化。数据直接检出与13–16世纪原住民农业相关的玉米和向日葵DNA，并显示农业、定居和加拿大雁活动与富营养化及藻华变化相伴。

**English.** Sedimentary ancient DNA from Crawford Lake reconstructs ecosystem change over roughly 1,300 years across plants, animals, algae, fungi and bacteria. The study directly detects maize and sunflower DNA associated with Indigenous farming between the thirteenth and sixteenth centuries and links agricultural settlement and Canada-goose activity with repeated eutrophication and algal change.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **适合待评估，不宜直接作为传统“田野发现”。** 其重要性主要是方法学和人地关系研究：它把湖泊沉积古DNA与已有考古、孢粉和地球化学证据整合起来。它同时纠正一个容易过时的说法：Crawford Lake曾在2023年被选为拟议“人类世”金钉子候选地，但该正式地质时代提议已在2024年被否决。

**English.** **Appropriate for under review rather than immediate promotion as a conventional field discovery.** Its significance is methodological and paleoecological, integrating sedaDNA with archaeological, palynological and geochemical records. The site was selected in 2023 as the candidate reference site for the proposed Anthropocene epoch, but that formal geological proposal was rejected in 2024.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Murchie, T. J., Emery, M. V., et al. (2026). Sedimentary ancient DNA tracks multi-kingdom ecosystem reorganizations following sequential human land use at Crawford Lake. *Molecular Ecology, 35*(17), e70529. https://doi.org/10.1111/mec.70529

## 13. 罗马统治与伊比利亚人口结构变化 | Roman colonization and population change in Iberia

**研究性质 | Nature of the study**  
**中文。** Carrión等报告243名公元100–800年古代个体的新基因数据，并与58名已发表个体联合分析。研究识别出罗马时期来自东地中海和北非的显著祖源输入；相比之下，5世纪以后日耳曼和Alan政治集团到来后，伊比利亚本地人口整体连续性更强。

**English.** Carrión and colleagues report new genetic data from 243 individuals dating to AD 100–800 and analyze them together with 58 previously published individuals. The study identifies substantial Eastern Mediterranean and North African ancestry influx during Roman rule, whereas population continuity remained stronger after fifth-century Germanic and Alan political takeovers.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **高质量古基因组研究，先留待评估。** 样本量和问题意识都很强，能够比较“帝国殖民”与“后罗马政治迁徙”对人口的不同影响。但它属于跨31处遗址的大尺度古基因组综合，而不是单一考古发现，是否晋升取决于本站最终对“综合性新认识”的权重。

**English.** **High-quality archaeogenomic research, retained under review.** The sample and comparative design directly address the contrasting demographic effects of Roman imperial integration and post-Roman political migrations. As a synthesis across 31 archaeological sites rather than a single field discovery, promotion depends on how strongly the final list weights large-scale interpretive advances.

**Publication / 出版物**  
Carrión, P., et al. (2026). Contrasting demographic impacts of Roman colonization and early medieval migrations in the Iberian Peninsula. *Cell*. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2026.09.052

## 14. 加泰罗尼亚Cova de la Font Major旧石器时代洞穴刻画 | Palaeolithic engravings at Cova de la Font Major, Catalonia

**地区与年代 | Region and date**  
L’Espluga de Francolí, Catalonia, Spain / 西班牙加泰罗尼亚；主要与早期上旧石器时代背景相关，部分图像的直接年代仍待进一步确定。

**主要发现 | Major findings**  
**中文。** Vergès Bosch与Salas-Altès系统发表了2019年识别的Cova de la Font Major洞穴刻画，共记录280个图像单元，其中55个为动物形象。就动物图像数量而言，它成为伊比利亚地中海沿岸目前第三大的旧石器时代洞穴艺术组合，也是东部伊比利亚目前唯一达到这一规模的洞穴艺术遗址。洞穴深部同时存在约40,000–26,000年前的人类活动年代背景。

**English.** Vergès Bosch and Salas-Altès formally document 280 engraved motifs identified at Cova de la Font Major, including 55 zoomorphic figures. By number of animal representations it is now the third-largest Palaeolithic parietal-art assemblage along the Iberian Mediterranean façade and the only large assemblage of this scale known in the eastern peninsula. Human activity in the deeper cave is independently documented in contexts dating roughly 40,000–26,000 years ago.

**学术判断 | Assessment**  
**中文。** **高优先级待评估。** 它显著改变了对东北伊比利亚旧石器时代艺术“缺席”的认识，而且有完整的*Antiquity*同行评议论文和Nature News报道。需要保留的限制是：许多图像目前主要依靠考古背景和风格比较归入前Magdalenian阶段，直接年代仍有限，不能把全部280个图像都简单写成“26,000年前”。

**English.** **High-priority under review.** The assemblage substantially changes the perceived geographic gap in Palaeolithic cave art in north-eastern Iberia and is supported by a full peer-reviewed *Antiquity* publication. The key limitation is chronology: many engravings are assigned to pre-Magdalenian phases through archaeological context and stylistic comparison rather than direct dating, so the entire corpus should not be described simply as “26,000 years old.”

**Publication / 出版物**  
Vergès Bosch, J. M., & Salas-Altès, M. (2026). Filling gaps: The Palaeolithic rock art of the Cova de la Font Major on the north-east Iberian Peninsula. *Antiquity*, 1–22. https://doi.org/10.15184/aqy.2026.10447
